e: The federal government imposes governor's rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and removes the PTI-led provincial government, accusing that it failed to combat insurgency.
Pakistan launches air strikes on what is described as "terrorist camps" in Afghanistan.
Eleven people are killed in an bomb attack in Dera Ismail Khan claimed by the TTP.
The Pakistani military launches air strikes on Afghanistan in retaliation for the Kohat attack.
The Pakistani military launches air strikes on Afghanistan in retaliation for the Kohat attack.
Aleema Khanum, the sister of former prime minister Imran Khan, is arrested on suspicion of plotting to mobilise his supporters amid planned protests.
At least 31 people, including 17 police personnel are killed in a terrorist attack on a police facility in Kohat.
An MOU is signed with the Pakistan army by US drone maker Powerus, which is set to merge with a firm backed by US President Donald Trump’s sons.
The Pakistan-China Boundary Joint Commission is formally inaugurated in Islamabad.
A Pakistan Navy vessel collides with an Indian Navy vessel in the Arabian Sea, prompting diplomatic protests between both countries.
A military drone strikes a suspected hideout of Balochistan militants.
Security forces kill 15 militants trying to cross the border from Afghanistan.
Pakistan and Kuwait sign a new defense accord.
At least 14 infants are killed in a fire at the maternity ward of the Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences in Islamabad.
The Pakistan Army kills 49 militants in Khyber Pakhtunhkwa and Balochistan during multiple operations.
Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Turkey sign a joint defense agreement.
At least 14 people are killed in a suicide bombing at an antimilitant rally in Kabal Tehsil, Khyber Pakhtunhkwa.
At least 34 miners are killed in a methane gas explosion at a coal mine near Quetta.
Entrepreneur and Wafflix founder Mir Raza Ali Khan is abducted after leaving his home and is found dead in Gulistan-e-Johar, Karachi.
Four climbers are killed while six others are reported missing following an avalanche on Broad Peak in Gilgit-Baltistan.

Twenty-seven people, including 15 security personnel are killed in a suicide car bombing carried out by the Pakistani Taliban in Tank District. The Pakistani military claims 12 militants were killed in the attack.
The United States imposes a 10% tariff on Pakistani exports, citing the presence of alleged forced labour in the supply chain.
A Boeing 737 aircraft operated by K2 Airways as K2 Airways Flight 1732 crashes into the Arabian Sea off Ormara, leaving its five crew missing.

At least 42 people, including 38 security personnel and four civilians, are killed in a series of attacks by militants across Balochistan. The Pakistani military claimed 54 militants were killed in these attacks.
At least 40 people are killed when an overloaded bus crashes into a ravine in Zhob District, Balochistan.
Fourteen children are killed and at least eight others are injured after the roof of a private tuition centre collapses in the Kahna area of Lahore.
Pakistan launches airstrikes in eastern Afghanistan in retaliation for the attack on Karachi the previous day.
A magnitude 5.4 earthquake hits Balochistan, injuring 20 people.
Three Sindh Rangers personnel and six militants are killed in an attack on their headquarters in Karachi claimed by Jamaat-ul-Ahrar.
A magnitude 5.2 earthquake hits Balochistan, injuring 20 people.

Human rights activist Mahrang Baloch is sentenced to life imprisonment by an court in Quetta on charges of murder and terrorism involving the killing of a Federal Constabulary official during a protest in Gwadar in 2024.
Seven people are killed in two successive roadside bomb attacks in Bannu District, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
A PAC MFI-17 Mushshak of the Pakistan Air Force crashes near Mardan, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, killing both pilots.
Fifteen people are killed in clashes between police and JAAC supporters in Azad Kashmir.
A van plunges into a ravine and catches fire near Khajut, Punjab, killing 10 people and injuring 13 others.
A strike is carried out across Azad Kashmir following a call from the JAAC in protest against overrepresentation of refugees from Indian-controlled Kashmir in the Azad Kashmir Legislative Assembly.
Seven people are killed in clashes between police and supporters of the Joint Awami Action Committee (JAAC) in Rawalakot, Azad Kashmir.
A magnitude 4.6 earthquake hits Malakwal, killing one person and injuring 11 others.
A minibus collides with a parked bus near Mardan, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, killing 17 people and injuring five.
At least 30 people are killed and 100 injured in a suicide bombing on a train transporting military personnel in Quetta. The Balochistan Liberation Army claims responsibility.
